research.title: Understand Slope of a Line
research.retrieval: Primary HTML slope, two-point differences, zero/undefined slope sections and current footer read. No embedded video or learner trial.
research.adopted: Signed rise divided by run in the same point order; horizontal zero and vertical undefined are different.
research.rejected: No prose, examples, figures or tasks copied. No readiness quiz, compulsory method, perpendicular-line scope or efficacy inference.
research.licence: Current book footer: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; separate commercial and AI/LLM restrictions stated. Reference only, no clearance claim.

research.title: Use the Slope–Intercept Form of an Equation of a Line
research.retrieval: Primary HTML intercept/graph sections and current footer read.
research.adopted: Separate k from b; intercept (0,b), two distinct x-values and exact substitution.
research.rejected: Original Finnish wording, numbers and diagrams; no copied exercise sequence or formal process/mastery claim.
research.licence: Current book footer: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; commercial and AI/LLM restrictions stated. Not publication clearance.

research.title: Year 8: Algebra — Graphs
research.retrieval: Primary teaching-planning HTML and terms-of-use page read; linked external resources not reviewed.
research.adopted: Label axes and scales, connect tables to graphs, use two points that need not include the origin.
research.rejected: The page calls vertical gradient infinite: rejected in favour of undefined division by zero. Foreign year mapping does not override canonical Finnish7–9 or justify efficacy. No copied text/figures.
research.licence: Terms: Commonwealth material CC BY 4.0 unless indicated; logos/trademarks/third-party exceptions retained. No rights clearance inferred.

draw.prompt: Piirrä suora y = −x + 1: merkitse pisteet, kun x = 0 ja x = 2.
draw.hint: Kun x = 0, y = b. Toinen piste: sijoita x = 2.

lines.prompt: Yhdistä jokainen kuvaus oikeaan yhtälöön. Yksi yhtälö jää yli.
lines.hint: x:n kerroin k kertoo nousun, vakio b leikkauskohdan y-akselilla.
lines.explanation: y = 2x + 1, y = 2x − 3 ja y = −2x + 1. Yhtälössä y = x + 2 k ja b ovat vaihtaneet paikkaa.

intercept.prompt: Missä pisteessä suora y = 2x − 1 leikkaa y-akselin?

transfer.prompt: Missä kohdassa suora y = −2x − 4 leikkaa x-akselin? Anna x.
transfer.hint: x-akselilla y on nolla. Ratkaise yhtälö.
